parameters.content:
## CBOE options to dealer positioning

No API key. CBOE publishes free delayed options quotes with greeks + OI. This pulls the 12-symbol watchlist 3x each weekday, parses each chain into per-strike cells, and iris_positioning_ingest computes dealer GEX, the gamma/zero-gamma flip, and the call/put walls. The Investing Positioning surface reads it live.
